full.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of a lung tissue sample stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The section shows lung parenchyma with pink hyaline membranes lining the alveolar spaces. These features are characteristic of hyaline membrane disease, also known as respiratory distress syndrome of the newborn.

random.description: This is a low-power histological micrograph showing a bone marrow biopsy section. The tissue exhibits a significant decrease in hematopoietic cellularity, which is largely replaced by adipose (fat) tissue spaces. The bony trabeculae are also visible throughout the specimen. These findings are characteristic of aplastic anemia or marked hypocellular bone marrow.
